title: Danger meter: text + icon + bar, Comfortable / Tough / Too hot, phone one row
steps: Realm world, Lv 1 / 3 / 8 heroes, walk with WASD, then teleport (test hook) to each zone
expected: label word + icon + bar that follows area level vs hero level
actual: Lv1 Shore 'Tough' (!), Lv3 Shore 'Comfortable' (check), Lv1/3/8 Midlands/Highlands/Godlands 'Too hot' (skull); aria 'Danger here: Too hot (area Lv 11, you Lv 1)'. Phone: one 17 px row inside #rw-zone, 12 px text. Hidden while a boss bar is up (by design). 0 page errors, 0 DB attempts.

title: Quest board level hints and zone-scaled rewards
steps: Nexus, walk to Quest Giver, press E (desktop) / tap Talk (phone)
expected: level hint per quest, reward scaled to zone
actual: Lv3 board: 'Defeat 22 creatures in the Godlands +172, brown bag, Lv 15+'; 'Defeat a boss +140 purple bag Lv 5+'; 'Open a portal +80 pink bag'. Lv1 board: 'Defeat 8 creatures in the Shore +46'. Claim buttons outline-disabled with progress bars.

title: Notebook panel: first kill writes a page, Esc order, focus
steps: Lv1 hero, real combat (hold Space + move) ~15 s: 2 kills
enter Nexus (Enter), click Notebook, Esc, Esc
expected: one page, Esc closes notebook then Nexus, focus returns
actual: 2 kills of a Water Elemental wrote exactly 1 page (kill:aimed:water_elemental@0); button 'Notebook (1)', aria 'Hero notebook: 1 page, 1 new this visit'; opening focuses Close; Esc 1 closes notebook, focus on the Notebook button, Nexus stays; Esc 2 closes Nexus. Boss/dungeon/tame pages and the N key NOT played.

title: Torches seen with glow; banners and NPC motion not seen

actual: Torch with warm glow visible next to the Bramble portal (img 10). Banners sit at rows 3-4 and were never inside the camera view I used, so not observed. NPC bob not judged from stills (no video).

actual: dry grass / rock seam and snow / dirt / grass seams show clean outlined inner corners. No qualifying lava or gravel concave tile within 260x260 of seed 12345 (not tested).
